digest.component_or_area: CI module-size gate and transition_close command
propositions: transition_close.py (803 LOC) exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap, causing the Module-size gate to fail and block all Gerrit changes from reaching Verified +1

The completion-verification precheck functions (_completion_precheck, _has_live_replacement_link, _is_live_ticket, _referencing_commit_exists, and _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES) form a self-contained call-graph cluster that can be extracted into a new sibling module without breaking existing callers

The new transition_close_precheck.py module must be imported and bound at the module level in transition_close.py so that monkeypatching and dynamic lookup by close_ticket preserve the existing test interception behavior

All existing tests (llm_failure_matrix, close_gate_step_budget, plan_review_close_gate_lifecycle, attested_signing, idea_close_bypass, completion_gate, etc.) must pass without assertion changes after the move, and only test_transition_close.py's import path for _referencing_commit_exists needs to be repointed

A new seam test must verify the binding contract: that transition_close._completion_precheck is the same object as transition_close_precheck._completion_precheck, and that monkeypatching the transition_close copy is observed by close_ticket
Post-split sizes must both be within the 100–800 LOC policy band, with transition_close.py targeting 200–500 LOC and transition_close_precheck.py targeting above 100 LOC
